description: registerNode: the node declares its owner once (a person or an enterprise); the platform answers with the node's single id, who owns it, and every org it now serves. Each scope's shares is the enterprise's per-org weight — a setting on the enterprise the platform serves as part of the owner contract, absent or 0 meaning equal shares. The runsheet goal a-node-has-an-owner serves this same shape at /contracts/registerNode.json — the platform side of the contract. Each scope's cap is the node's connection to the org's cap on its concurrent sessions there (runsheet ADR 066, decision 11): 0 is none. Its connectionId is that connection (ADR 066) and its product the connection's product, runsheet: the node keys the connection's clones and package stores by the id (mesh-cli ADR-039).

inputNotes.credentialId: the Latchkey machine id of the node's own credential (the uuid after "machine:" in the bearer's sub): a machine bearer sends its machine id, and the platform's registersNode refuses one that names another; a person's rs_* bearer sends none. Sent only when the gateway's RegisterNodeInput takes it (runsheet#2290 and later).
